description: A study lined with tall wooden bookcases in warm orange-brown, shown straight on. The shelves hold a purple and a cyan glass flask, a row of colored books, a green domed object and a small stand. Over the right-hand bookcase looms a ghostly figure, shown from the waist up and facing the viewer: a skull-like face with dark eye sockets and a green tint, a hooded head wrapped in streaky grey, blue and cyan shrouds, and one bony white hand reaching out to the left over the books. Its outline flickers with speckled red and blue, as if barely solid. The mood is spooky and sudden. Frame 1: the phantom hangs in front of the shelves, hand outstretched. Frame 2: it is gone, and the right-hand bookcase stands dark and empty. The ghost is shown briefly and the empty shelves are held about twice as long, so the loop reads as an apparition flickering into view and vanishing again.
title: Ghost appearing among bookshelves
